description: Land Acquisition - Watareka and Godagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that multiple parcels of land are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
